facts.fact: MyJoyOnline reports Trade Minister Elizabeth Ofosu-Adjare launched the National Non-Tariff Barriers Reporting and Resolution Platform, which takes complaints by web, WhatsApp, social media and USSD and has AI capabilities to process them.
